author: agent:claude-code
message: The checks declared with the commands they run (rules checks.commands and checks.contract, baseline 2026.10.22): --locked throughout, rustfmt now that the workspace is formatted, the no-std / lean / wasm builds the README lists, and the two release-only checks.

check.name: rustfmt
check.notes: rustfmt's defaults, applied once in 2df1de7. bindings/python and bench/rust are workspaces of their own: the same command there.

check.name: workspace tests
check.notes: Every crate's unit and integration tests (no_alloc, scipy_parity among them).

check.name: clippy
check.notes: Warnings denied, every optional feature on.

check.name: rustdoc
check.notes: With RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings, so a missing or broken doc fails.

check.name: cargo deny
check.run: cargo deny --workspace check advisories bans sources
check.notes: Advisories, bans and sources (deny.toml); licenses are tend check's. Needs cargo-deny installed.

check.name: tests without std
check.notes: The tests link std; the library under test doesn't.

check.name: lean tests
check.notes: units, simd and geometry only (default-features = false).

check.name: NEON tests
check.notes: Before a release, on an aarch64 machine (Apple Silicon or an ARM Linux host): the NEON paths. On x86 this runs the SSE/AVX paths instead, so it counts only on aarch64. Clippy there too: cargo clippy -p autodyne --lib --tests --features bytemuck --locked -- -D warnings.

check.name: Miri
check.run: cargo +nightly miri test --lib --features ndarray -- signal::nd dynamic:: dlpack interop
check.notes: Before a release. Nightly with the miri component; MIRIFLAGS=-Zmiri-strict-provenance -Zmiri-deterministic-floats. Undefined behaviour in the n-d views, runtime-typed views, DLPack and interop.
